counterfactual.change: halved dt from 0.01707 to 0.008536 (one field); finer substep resolution removes angular-momentum violation over same 25 steps

explanation: Three massive bodies (8.5, 11.6, 11.8 Msun, G~5) undergo a close triple encounter: by step 24 separations 0.11-0.58 with speeds up to ~19, substeps 20-22 per outer step. Leapfrog with adaptive substep splitting based on speed/acceleration under-resolves the rapidly varying softened forces at closest approach, producing systematic angular-momentum drift from -168.27 to -175.01 exceeding tolerance. Halving dt removes failure, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two blue bodies converge to almost complete overlap in steps 23-24 in a tight cluster. By step 25 they separate again with short curved trails indicating a rapid close encounter.
